AOSP GSI Insight can rebuild this APK so Android accepts it, and sign it with a key that stays on this device. The file you picked is not modified. Changes:
Raise the target SDK from %1$d to %2$d.
Install under a new package ID: %1$s
The file itself already meets this Android version\'s requirements. You can still install it next to the original:
Install next to the original (new package ID, separate data)
Without a new package ID the app would have to replace the installed original, which only works if both are signed with the same key. Otherwise uninstall the original first (its data is lost).
Raising the target SDK changes how Android treats the app (runtime permissions, background limits, storage access). Old apps may crash or lose features.

The signing key is created and kept on this device. If you uninstall AOSP GSI Insight or reset the device, apps patched with it can no longer be updated by new patched builds; they would have to be reinstalled.

Showing the fixed APK that AOSP GSI Insight just built and signed.
Open AOSP GSI Insight to install it.

This package is closed-source Google software (GApps). Google licenses it to device makers only, so this app does not provide, host or sell it. It only inspects and installs a file you obtained yourself; check that you are allowed to use it.

If installing fails with a permission or provider conflict, the system image probably already contains a stub (GApps, microG) that declares the same permissions. Remove or disable that package first; renaming the permissions would break the app.
Open alternatives: microG for Play Services, Aurora Store or F-Droid for apps, and the WebView that ships with AOSP.
AOSP GSI Insight is free for inspecting, checking, installing and fixing a single APK. Donations pay for the manager itself; they never unlock downloads of proprietary software.
Unity-based apps very often include advertising SDKs. These libraries alone do not prove that the app shows ads.

This package ID is in Google\'s namespace (com.google.android.*), but that does not prove the app comes from Google: third-party apps sometimes use it. Check the signing key in the Signatures card before trusting it.
Security: the APK is analyzed locally. AOSP GSI Insight does not install, run or modify the selected file.
